propositions: pytest-xdist worker process crashes with 'node down: Not properly terminated' and 'worker gwN crashed' on test_matching_guard_is_accepted, landing randomly on one of four matrix shards

Crash is Python 3.11-only and reproduces only in CI under xdist, not locally, because CPython issue 86296 causes asyncio.wait_for to consume external cancellation when child completes in same event-loop turn
Worker task loops back to queue.get() with cancelling()==1 while lifespan awaits it forever, causing pytest-timeout to kill the worker after 300s

Commit 8c9bf5d78d fixed the defect by replacing asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.to_thread(...), timeout=…) with async with asyncio.timeout(...): await asyncio.to_thread(...), restoring correct cancellation semantics

Original root-cause hypothesis about orphaned default-executor threads from asyncio.to_thread surviving portal teardown was falsified; the real mechanism is the cancellation-consumption bug in Python 3.11
Load-dependent teardown race in xdist worker-channel closure reproduces locally under CPU/memory contention, surfacing as OSError: cannot send (already closed?))
